initialSheetAttempt.prompt: Edit target: the supplied six-frame warrior walking sprite sheet. Precise lower-body correction ONLY. Keep the same 3 columns x 2 rows grid, same six upper bodies, identical face, helmet, torso armor, cape, right-hand cyan sword and left-hand gold lion shield, scale, elevated isometric SE direction. Redraw legs only below the hip guards: natural short grounded walking, NOT marching or kicking. Boots stay close to the ground, toe points down/forward during swing, knee flexes so heel folds behind the thigh rather than straight leg reaching far forward. Stride half as long as source. In frame 1 near/anatomical right leg contacts modestly ahead, far left trails. Frame 2 right supports under body and LEFT knee flexes as left foot passes under pelvis with toe pointing down. Frame 3 LEFT heel reaches a short low step ready to contact. Frame 4 LEFT foot contacts ahead, RIGHT leg trails, opposite anatomical leg to frame1. Frame5 LEFT supports under pelvis and RIGHT heel folds back/toe down as right foot passes. Frame6 RIGHT reaches a short low step ready to contact into frame1. Exactly two legs each, real left/right alternation, foot contact consistent baseline in all six cells, no spreading sideways, no high knees, no raised extended kicking boots, no body mirroring or changing heading. Preserve the approved upper half as exactly as possible. Six complete separate sprites each centered in equal square cells, 3x2 1536x1024 overall, consistent registration. Transparent RGBA background, no floor/shadow/labels/grid/text. Stylized cel-shaded mobile fantasy RPG matching source.
